response.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS a FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref HAVING AVG(humepct) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS oa FROM e), k AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.a FROM e, o WHERE e.a > o.oa), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ka FROM k) SELECT k.equipref, k.a AS avg_humidity, k.a - o.oa AS diff_from_overall_avg, k.a - m.ka AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k, o, m WHERE o.oa IS NOT NULL AND m.ka IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Equipment whose humepct readings are all NULL have a missing average and are excluded from the set of equipment averages, so they do not affect the overall average.
The mean of the kept equipment averages is computed over all equipment above the overall average, before the top-10 limit is applied.
The overall average is the unweighted mean of per-equipment averages, not the average of all readings, as the request states.
